adobe_api.status: No dedicated selection-tool route in the pinned published v2 contract. Tool/actionJSON descriptors remain unqualified; no invented Adobe route or model equivalence claim. Existing interfaces retain their coverage.

menus.toolbar: Existing Object Selection/Quick Selection W entries now execute; Selection Brush is in the Lasso group. Native options include selection modes, source sampling, refinement and Select and Mask where applicable.
menus.shortcut: Factory W group retained. Selection Brush has no primary shortcut. Full L-group cycling equivalence is unqualified.

limitations: People/person-part selection, Select/Mask All Objects, Object Finder hover/catalogue and broader S03 workflows remain open.
Exact Photoshop model/pixels/defaults, source Rust byte parity, real-photo quality/performance and full supported contexts remain unqualified.

Latest authoritative desktop state is locked; no re-probe. Offscreen layout and synthetic events are not live UI evidence. Physical Intel/macOS14/macOS26 and actual point Vision inference remain open.
Native analysis uses SDR/sRGB proxies and RGB-document targets. Channels/component-specific analysis is not implemented; nonraster source selection uses visible composite.
Actions save coverage on original canvas dimensions; adaptive redetection and full Adobe selection-tool action descriptors remain open.
actions: Version4 stores explicit resulting selection coverage and original canvas dimensions; replay does not repeat image detection. Versions1–3 remain readable; downgrading a coverage action rejects. Existing16MiB native library and60000-character base64 API import limits remain; large masks can exceed import limits.
